description: An ETH Zurich course team archives raw and analysis-ready data on waste in Zurich public spaces, gathered in spring 2022 with the city waste department. Zenodo lists one public release archive under CC BY 4.0. The linked GitHub README identifies team-level survey CSV files, waste-characterisation tables, cleaned derived data, variable codebooks and R cleaning scripts. The README makes the data structure more inspectable than the Zenodo file name alone. Surveys and characterised waste can inform behavioural assumptions or validate public-space waste-generation scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Zurich collection. A limitation is that the public description does not establish representative sampling of all Zurich public spaces, collection dates for each team, or measured citywide waste tonnage. The GitHub repository reports an unclassified licence, so the Zenodo archive’s CC BY claim should not be applied automatically to changing repository content. Neither the archive nor the CSV payloads were downloaded; code was not run.
